title: Cleartext storage of the WhatsApp Noise static private key in the shared application container (cck.dat) in WhatsApp…
description: WhatsApp Messenger for iOS stores the Noise protocol static private key in cleartext within the shared application container file cck.dat. This vulnerability allows an attacker who gains access to a full filesystem extraction or equivalent application data copy to recover long-term authentication material. With this key, the attacker can impersonate the victim's WhatsApp account. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-128974 and has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.5.
